name: Rabbitbrush & wildflowers
desc: Rabbitbrush, penstemons and other shrubs and flowers of the open ground. They feed insects, rabbits and bumblebees.
about: Ericameria nauseosa, commonly known as chamisa, rubber rabbitbrush, and gray rabbitbrush, is a shrub in the sunflower family (Aster) found in the arid regions of western North America.
